text: Main coursesCore undergraduate courses: Political Economy, Microeconomics, Macroeconomics, International Trade, International Trade Practice, International Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Econometrics, International Settlement, etcProfessional characteristicsKnowledge complexity: It integrates knowledge from multiple disciplines such as economics, management, and law. Students not only need to master economic theories but also be familiar with trade rules, business management, and foreign languages, among others.Practical application: Emphasis is placed on practical teaching. Through internships, training sessions, case analyses, and simulated transactions, students are enabled to master practical business operation skills, such as the preparation of foreign trade documents, customs declaration and inspection, and business negotiations.International perspective: Pay attention to global economic dynamics and changes in the international market, cultivate students' international vision and cross-cultural communication skills, and enable students to adapt to the business environment of different countries and regions.
